data.name: Aryvika
data.gender_notes: Aryvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aryvika is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'arya' meaning noble and 'vika' meaning place or abode. The name is often given to girls with pure and desirable qualities, symbolizing a noble dwelling or place. The name Aryvika carries the meaning “Noble, Pure, Desirable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aryvika usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, pure, desirable and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aryvika total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
